product_metadata.title: Tramontina Grill Pan with Press Enameled Cast Iron 11-in Graduated Red, 80131/059DS
features: PFOA and PTFE-free porcelain enamel ribbed cooking surface is non-reactive and easy-to-clean, lifting foods from grease for healthier cooking
For added versatility, press also fits 10 and 12 in. Tramontina cast-iron skillets and features solid cast stainless steel knob
Compatible with gas, electric, ceramic glass and induction cooktops
description: The enameled cast-iron 11-inch grill Pan with press is part of Tramontina's Gourmet collection of premium products engineered and manufactured with the finest design, materials and workmanship, outperforming similar products within the market and delivering the best quality and value to the cooking professional and enthusiast alike. Prized by cooks for superior heat distribution and retention this enameled cast-iron 11-inch grill pan with press provides outstanding cooking results and comes in a vibrant, gradated porcelain enamel exterior finish offering an elegant kitchen to table serving option. Equipped with a convenient helper handle for secure lifting and transferring from stovetop to tabletop and two pouring lips, this pan will soon become a staple in your kitchen for recipes that include frying, searing or browning. For added versatility, the handy press also fits the enameled cast-iron 10 and 12-inch skillets from the same enameled cast-iron collection! The grill pan has a matte black porcelain enamel cooking surface that is easy-to-clean and PFOA- and PTFE-free, and with its ribbed design, keeps food away from grease for healthier cooking. The Tramontina Gourmet enameled cast-iron 11 in grill pan with press is hand-wash only, compatible with all cooktops and oven-safe to 450 F. This product is assembled and packaged in USA and offered under a lifetime warranty.
